title: Empakaai and Olmoti: The Quiet Craters of the Highlands
excerpt: Beyond the famous crater lie the quiet highlands of Ngorongoro, with Empakaai and Olmoti craters. Walking, views and almost no other visitors.
body:
Most people visit the Ngorongoro Crater and drive on. Those who stay longer discover the highlands of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, with smaller craters, forests and Maasai villages.

## Empakaai Crater

Empakaai is a steep crater with a deep lake on its floor, often with flamingos. You can walk down to the lake with a ranger. The walk is steep but beautiful, with views of Ol Doinyo Lengai and, on clear days, Kilimanjaro.

## Olmoti Crater

A shallower crater with a short walk to a viewpoint and a waterfall. A good half-day hike.

## Walking in the highlands

Multi-day walks across the highlands, with donkeys carrying luggage, are possible with a guide and ranger. You walk between Maasai settlements, through grasslands and forest.

## Who it suits

- Active travellers who want to walk.
- People combining Ngorongoro with [Lake Natron](/blog/lake-natron-guide/).
- Repeat visitors looking for something different.

## Practical

Roads are rough, so allow time. Nights are cold at altitude.
